function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_custom_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of all custom event specifications configured in the system, including their details and current status. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_inactive.description: Whether to include inactive custom event specifications in the result.

search_term.description: An optional search term to filter the custom event specifications by name or description.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos
function.description: Retrieve a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications, providing an overview of event types available within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_custom.description: A flag to determine whether to include custom event specifications in the summary. If set to true, both built-in and custom event specifications will be included.

filter.description: An optional filter term to narrow down the summary to event specifications that contain the specified text in their name or description.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_built_in_event_specification
function.description: Retrieve the details of a built-in event specification using its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

eventSpecificationId.description: The unique identifier of the built-in event specification to retrieve.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos_by_ids
function.description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications given their unique identifiers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_ids.description: A list of event specification identifiers. Each identifier is a string representing a unique event.

include_details.description: A flag to determine whether detailed information of the events should be included. If set to true, additional event details are returned.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_built_in_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of specifications for all built-in events within the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ids.description: A list of identifiers for the events whose specifications are to be retrieved.
